title: 先定義預測目標與決策邊界
Define the prediction target and decision boundary
lead: 設計社群動態中的廣告點擊預測。第一版負責為合格候選輸出可信的 pCTR；候選檢索、競價、pacing 與使用者體驗限制是相鄰元件，必須說明契約。

Design click prediction for ads in a social feed. The first version outputs trustworthy pCTR for eligible candidates. Retrieval, auction, pacing, and user-experience constraints are adjacent components with explicit contracts.

title: 貫穿全篇的假設
Running assumptions
text: 使用者打開 feed，系統需為一組合格廣告預測「實際曝光後 W 內的有效落地頁點擊」。範例假設每秒 1,000 個請求、每次精排 200 個廣告、精排服務 p99 預算 80 ms。所有流量、窗口、模型尺寸與 SLO 都是設計練習的假設，應向面試官確認；不是 Meta 公開規格。

A user opens the feed; predict a valid landing-page click within W after an actual impression for each eligible ad. Illustrative assumptions: 1,000 requests/s, 200 candidates per ranking request, and an 80 ms p99 ranking-service budget. Traffic, windows, model sizes, and SLOs are exercise assumptions to clarify, not published Meta specifications.

blocks.text:
pCTR = P(valid click within W | user u, ad a, context c, impression)
Decision unit: one rendered impression
Serving output: pCTR + model_version + feature_version + freshness status

rows: 什麼算 click？
What counts as a click?
有效落地頁點擊；重複／無效事件有明確規則。
A valid landing-page click, with explicit duplicate/invalid-event rules.
展開圖片、誤觸、購買不能混為同一個 label。
Image expansion, accidental taps, and purchases are distinct targets.
在哪裡預測？
Where is the prediction used?
候選精排，條件包含已知版位。
Candidate ranking conditioned on a known placement.
多個 slot 要逐 slot 評估或另建曝光模型；不能偷用未知最終位置。
For multiple slots, score per slot or model exposure separately; do not leak the unknown final position.
如何定義成功？
What is success?
離線先看機率品質，線上預先選定主要價值指標。
Probability quality offline, a prespecified value metric online.
CTR、收入、轉換與長期滿意度不同；設負回饋、延遲與成本護欄。
CTR, revenue, conversion, and long-term satisfaction differ; guard negative feedback, latency, and cost.
需要哪些資料？
What data is available?
經允許使用的互動、creative、版位及版本化紀錄。
Permitted interactions, creatives, placements, and versioned logs.
明確定義資料保留、刪除傳遞、線上可用性與缺值語意。
Specify retention, deletion propagation, serving availability, and missing-value semantics.

text: 以 CPC 為例，bid × pCTR 可作預期點擊出價價值的一部分，但不是完整拍賣公式。投放還受品質、預算、pacing 與 eligibility 約束。先保持預測服務輸出可解釋的機率，再由下游決定效用；不要把任意商業權重混進 label 後仍稱輸出為 pCTR。

For CPC ads, bid × pCTR can contribute to expected bid value, but is not a complete auction formula. Delivery also depends on quality, budgets, pacing, and eligibility. Keep the prediction service's output interpretable as a probability and let downstream logic define utility. Arbitrary business-weighted labels do not automatically preserve pCTR semantics.

q: 90 秒開場如何回答？
How do you open in 90 seconds?
a: 我先確認 click、曝光與時間窗，將核心任務定義為合格候選的條件點擊機率。我會先畫線上 scoring 與離線學習閉環，再定義曝光／點擊 join、時間一致特徵和成熟標籤。建立 LR baseline，依交互與行為歷史假說增加模型能力；用未來時段的 log loss、校準和 slices 驗證。最後討論 A/B、延遲與資料故障時的止損。

I will clarify clicks, impressions, and the prediction window, then define the core task as a conditional click probability for eligible candidates. I will draw serving and learning paths, define impression-click joins, point-in-time features, and mature labels, and establish an LR baseline. I will add capacity for explicit interaction or history hypotheses, validate on future periods with log loss, calibration, and slices, then cover A/B tests, latency, and safeguards against data failures.

title: 線上決策與離線學習閉環
Serving decisions and the learning loop
lead: 圖上每一條箭頭都要說得出 payload、時間與錯誤行為。訓練不是 request 的同步相依；模型品質卻依賴 request 日誌的正確性。
For every arrow, explain the payload, timing, and failure behavior. Training is not a synchronous request dependency, but model quality depends on correct request logging.

Illustrative API; define field and error contracts in implementation

text: 容量先做算術：1,000 requests/s × 200 ads = 200,000 candidate scores/s。不能據此宣稱需要幾張 GPU；先量 feature lookup、序列長度、batch、模型 FLOPs、memory bandwidth 與尾延遲。保留 request-level batching，避免 200 次小 RPC；critical path 用 trace 量測，階段 p99 不可直接相加。

Start with workload arithmetic: 1,000 requests/s × 200 ads = 200,000 candidate scores/s. This does not determine GPU count. Measure feature lookup, sequence lengths, batching, FLOPs, memory bandwidth, and tail latency. Batch candidates per request instead of making 200 tiny RPCs. Trace the critical path; stage p99 values are not additive.

title: 資料準備：曝光、延遲回饋與時間切分
Data preparation: exposure, delayed feedback, and temporal splits
lead: 一筆訓練資料是一次有效曝光，以及那次決策當下已知的特徵。先確保標籤與時間正確，才討論模型。
One example is one valid impression with features available at that decision. Establish label and time correctness before choosing a model.

Minimal data contract; preserve event and availability times

text: 在曝光 ID 上做有時間限制的 keyed join；先去重，再依固定歸因規則建立 label。label=0 需要觀測窗結束且相關資料源健康、處理進度足夠；不是「目前沒有 join 到 click」。事件遺失無法靠等久一點修好，應隔離受影響時段並回補。晚到修正需更新同一個 example version，避免把同一曝光當兩個互相矛盾的訓練樣本。

Use a bounded keyed join on impression identity, deduplicate, and apply a fixed attribution rule. A zero label requires a completed window, healthy sources, and sufficient processing progress; it is not merely the absence of a click so far. Waiting does not repair lost events: quarantine and backfill affected periods. Late corrections update the same example version rather than creating contradictory duplicate examples.

q: 為什麼只有 event_time < impression_time 還不夠？
Why is event_time < impression_time insufficient?
a: 某個行為雖發生得早，卻在曝光後才被系統收到。若 offline aggregate 使用它，而 online 當時不可能知道，就有 availability leakage。理想用 serving snapshot；若重建特徵，同時檢查 event time 和資料可用時間，並以 replay 比對線上輸入。

An event may occur earlier but arrive after the impression. Including it offline leaks information unavailable to serving. Prefer logged serving snapshots; when reconstructing features, check both event time and availability time, and compare replayed tensors with online inputs.

q: 要不要完全按 user 切分？
Should users be completely disjoint across splits?
a: 主要評估要模擬未來服務，故以時間切分，同一使用者可以再次出現；這本身不是洩漏。另用 disjoint users／ads 評估冷啟動，並說明它回答的是不同問題。所有標籤衍生統計仍須嚴格 point-in-time。

Use temporal splits to represent future serving; recurring users are not inherently leakage. Add disjoint-user/ad evaluations for cold start and explain that they answer a different question. Label-derived statistics must remain strictly point-in-time.

title: 抽樣、曝光偏差與機率校準
Sampling, exposure bias, and probability calibration
lead: 類別不平衡、計算成本與曝光偏差是三個問題。negative sampling 可以省算力，但不會自動修好選擇偏差。
Class imbalance, compute cost, and exposure bias are distinct problems. Negative sampling saves compute; it does not automatically fix selection bias.

blocks.text:
q = P(y=1 | x, retained)
s1 = P(retained | y=1),  s0 = P(retained | y=0)
q/(1-q) = (s1/s0) * p/(1-p)
p = s0*q / [s1*(1-q) + s0*q]
logit(p) = logit(q) + log(s0/s1)
Example: q=0.10, s1=1, s0=0.10 → p≈0.010989

text: 這是 Bayes rule 的推導，前提是保留率只依 label（或已知每個 x 的保留率），而 q 確實代表抽樣分布。另一條路是使用 1/s_y 的 inverse-probability weighted BCE 估原始風險；兩條路不能不加分析地疊用，否則重複修正。Hard-negative mining 依 x 選樣，不能套一個全域負例率就宣稱已還原。

This follows from Bayes' rule when retention depends only on the label, or when retention conditional on x is known, and q represents the sampled distribution. Alternatively, inverse-probability weighted BCE using 1/s_y estimates original risk. Do not blindly combine weighting with posterior correction: that can double-correct. Hard-negative mining depends on x and cannot generally be undone with one global negative-retention rate.

Position and examination

低樣本 slice 需 shrinkage；校準器不能補救缺失標籤或錯誤 feature。
Small slices need shrinkage; calibration cannot repair missing labels or broken features.

q: 為什麼不直接用 SMOTE 或 focal loss？
Why not immediately use SMOTE or focal loss?
a: 任意插值類別 ID 或 embeddings 不一定代表有效曝光。Focal loss 重新加權難例，可能改善某些目標，但不能假設輸出仍是原始 CTR。先以正確標籤、BCE、抽樣修正建立 baseline；任何新 loss 都需比較校準、排序、slice 與成本。

Interpolating categorical IDs or embeddings need not create valid impressions. Focal loss reweights hard examples and may help some objectives, but its output is not automatically the original CTR. Establish correct labels, BCE, and sampling correction first; evaluate any alternative loss on calibration, discrimination, slices, and cost.

title: 特徵工程：訊號、時序與可用性
Feature engineering: signal, time, and availability
lead: 每個 feature 都要有定義、來源、可用時間、缺值語意與實驗證據。增加一個特徵，同時增加訓練和 serving 的相依。
Every feature needs a definition, source, availability time, missing-value semantics, and experimental evidence. A feature creates dependencies in both training and serving.

smoothed_CTR = (clicks + alpha) / (impressions + alpha + beta)
prior_mean = alpha / (alpha + beta)
All counts: event_time < impression_time AND available_by(impression_time)
Numeric processing: train-fit clipping / log1p / normalization + missing indicator
Sparse processing: vocabulary + OOV OR versioned hashing + collision analysis

text: 平滑 prior 只用 train 資料估計，可按 advertiser／category 做有足夠支持的階層共享。缺失不是零：沒有歷史與確實觀測到零次互動需分開表示。Hashing 可限制 vocabulary，但碰撞會混合不同 ID；固定 seed 與 bucket 規則，量測頻率分布與碰撞敏感度。不要每次 retrain 改 ID 映射卻沿用舊 embedding。

Estimate smoothing priors from training data only, with hierarchical sharing across sufficiently supported advertisers/categories. Missing is not zero: no history differs from an observed zero count. Hashing bounds vocabulary but collisions mix identities; version the seed/bucket rules and measure frequency and collision sensitivity. Never change ID mappings while blindly reusing old embeddings.

q: 新的廣告完全沒有 click，如何預測？
How do you score an ad with no clicks?
a: 以 creative 內容、類別、advertiser prior 與 context 做初始估計，ID 路徑用 OOV／新 ID 初始化。看曝光量分層的校準與 learning curve，評估是否需要有限探索。不能把低樣本高 CTR 直接視為高品質，也不能把未知廣告永久壓低而無法學習。

Start with creative content, category, advertiser priors, and context, using OOV or new-ID initialization for the ID path. Evaluate calibration and learning curves by exposure count, and consider bounded exploration. A high CTR from a tiny sample is not reliable quality; permanently suppressing unknown ads also prevents learning.

lead: 先提出可被推翻的假說，再選模型。一次改動 feature、sampling 和模型，很難知道改善來自哪裡。

p_i = sigmoid(z_i)

text: 初始選擇：LR＋必要 crosses，之後固定資料、特徵與 split 比較 DeepFM 或 DCNv2。記錄 seeds、HPO 次數、training wall time、模型／optimizer 記憶體和 serving 成本。先看 loss 曲線和切片：train 好、validation 差可能是稀疏 ID 過擬合或 drift；兩者都差則查標籤、特徵、容量與 optimizer。

Start with LR and necessary crosses, then compare DeepFM or DCNv2 using fixed data, features, and splits. Record seeds, HPO trials, training wall time, model/optimizer memory, and serving cost. Inspect loss curves and slices: strong training but weak validation suggests sparse-ID overfitting or drift; poor performance on both calls for label, feature, capacity, and optimizer checks.

title: 多目標延伸：不要混淆條件機率
Multi-objective extension: preserve conditioning
text: 若產品要看 conversion，可另建 pCVR 與相關 head，但需定義是 P(conversion | click, impression) 還是 P(conversion | impression)。只有 conversion 必經定義中的 click 且窗口一致時，才能按機率鏈式法則寫 pCTCVR = pCTR × pCVR。View-through conversions 需要不同事件建模；不同 label maturity 也會影響訓練。

If conversion matters, add a corresponding head with an explicit target: P(conversion | click, impression) or P(conversion | impression). The chain-rule form pCTCVR = pCTR × pCVR applies only when conversion requires the defined click and windows align. View-through conversions require different event modeling, and label maturity differs across objectives.

q: 為什麼不用更大的 Transformer 一步到位？
Why not start with a larger Transformer?
a: 如果沒有可靠 sequence、時間資訊或充足資料，容量可能只記住熱門 ID。先量 LR／interaction baseline 的瓶頸，提出序列順序或長期意圖假說，再比較 shuffled-history、pooled-history 與 ordered-history 對照。收益需在公平調參及延遲預算下成立。

Without reliable sequences, timing, and enough data, capacity may memorize popular IDs. Diagnose the LR/interaction baseline, then test an order or long-term-intent hypothesis using shuffled, pooled, and ordered histories. Gains must survive fair tuning and latency constraints.

title: 行為序列與可共用的使用者表示
Behavior sequences and reusable user representations
lead: 同一使用者對不同廣告可能有不同相關歷史。長期 user representation 與當前 candidate 的 matching 應有清楚分工。
Different ads can make different parts of a user's history relevant. Separate long-term user representation from matching to the current candidate.

text: DIN 用候選廣告條件化的 local activation 聚合歷史，提供一個可讀的起點。候選感知不等於時間順序建模：若只把歷史當 set，交換事件順序不一定改變結果。要主張 recency／order 有用，加入時間差、position 或相應序列結構，並做控制實驗。

DIN uses candidate-conditioned local activation to aggregate history and is a readable starting point. Candidate awareness is not temporal-order modeling: treating history as a set need not change under permutation. Claims about recency or order require time gaps, positions, or a suitable sequence structure, plus controlled experiments.

text: Online learning 增加資料速度，也縮短錯誤標籤污染模型的時間。設資料健康 gate、限制發布頻率、保留 last-known-good bundle，且先將訓練與 serving 更新解耦。Replay 消費要定義 offset 與去重策略；恢復時的重複樣本會改變權重，即使 pipeline 沒有報錯。

Online learning increases freshness and the speed at which bad labels contaminate a model. Gate on data health, bound release frequency, preserve a last-known-good bundle, and decouple training from serving updates. Define offset and deduplication policies for replay: duplicate examples after recovery change effective weights even if the pipeline reports success.

q: GPU utilization 很低，是否應換更大模型？
Low GPU utilization: should the model get larger?
a: 先 profile input decode、embedding lookup、通信、CPU／GPU copy、batch waiting 和 kernels。Utilization 低可能是 I/O 或 all-to-all bound，不是模型太小。分開報 examples/s、request latency 與品質；用實測瓶頸選改善方式。

Profile input decoding, embedding lookup, communication, CPU/GPU transfers, batch waiting, and kernels. Low utilization can be I/O or all-to-all bound, not evidence of insufficient model size. Report examples/s, request latency, and quality separately, and optimize the measured bottleneck.

title: 離線評估：辨識力、校準與可信比較
Offline evaluation: discrimination, calibration, credible comparisons
lead: 同一個 AUC 可以對應不同的機率尺度；一個整體校準比例也可能掩蓋互相抵消的分群錯誤。
The same AUC can coexist with different probability scales; one aggregate calibration ratio can hide offsetting slice errors.

blocks.text:
LogLoss = mean[-y*log(p) - (1-y)*log(1-p)]
NE_eval = LogLoss / H(mean(y_eval))
H(r) = -r*log(r) - (1-r)*log(1-r)
Calibration ratio = sum(p) / sum(y)   # ideal: 1; undefined if no clicks
Brier = mean((p-y)^2)
NE can exceed 1. For all-positive/all-negative sets, H=0: do not report NE.

text: 本篇公式採 evaluation empirical CTR 作 entropy 分母，明確標為 NE_eval。也可用 train CTR 定義 reference predictor 並報相對 log loss，但必須寫清楚分母與期間，不能把不同定義的 NE 混比。跨時段 base rate 改變時，同時看 raw loss、base rate 與分群結果；normalized 指標不能保證不同流量可直接比較。

The formula here uses evaluation-set empirical CTR in the entropy denominator and labels it NE_eval. Another convention uses a train-CTR reference predictor and reports relative log loss. State the denominator and period; do not compare different NE conventions as if identical. Across base-rate shifts, inspect raw loss, base rate, and slices too; normalization does not make all traffic directly comparable.

q: AUC 提升 0.001，要發布嗎？
AUC improves by 0.001: should you ship?
a: 這只是一個訊號。先看 paired uncertainty、rolling windows、log loss、校準與重要 slices，再量模型成本與服務差異。若一致改善且符合護欄，進入小流量受控實驗；不能從離線 AUC 直接推論收入收益。

That is one signal. Check paired uncertainty, rolling windows, log loss, calibration, key slices, and serving cost/parity. Consistent gains within guardrails justify a controlled small-traffic experiment; offline AUC alone does not establish revenue lift.

title: 離線反事實評估的邊界
Limits of off-policy evaluation
text: IPS／SNIPS／doubly robust 方法需要明確 logging policy、overlap 和 outcome 定義。舊策略從未曝光的廣告沒有可靠 support；極小 propensity 產生高 variance，clipping 又引入 bias。預算與競價的動態效果也不會因一個 estimator 自動重現。把它作篩選與診斷工具，不能取代所有線上實驗。

IPS, SNIPS, and doubly robust methods require a specified logging policy, overlap, and outcome. Ads never exposed by the old policy lack support; tiny propensities create high variance, while clipping introduces bias. Dynamic budget and auction effects are not automatically reproduced. Use off-policy estimates for screening and diagnosis, not as a universal replacement for online experiments.

title: 線上實驗：成功指標與因果邊界
Online experiments: outcomes and causal boundaries
lead: 模型品質改善是起點。真正要回答的是：在固定的投放與量測條件下，新的預測是否改善預先定義的產品結果？
Model quality is a starting point. Does the new prediction improve a prespecified product outcome under controlled delivery and measurement conditions?

rows: Hypothesis
Hypothesis
新特徵／模型改善價值指標，且不增加負回饋、latency、timeout。
A feature/model improves a value metric without worsening negative feedback, latency, or timeouts.
一次只改可歸因的 bundle；改 auction 規則需另定義 treatment。
Change an attributable bundle; auction-rule changes define a different treatment.
Assignment
Assignment
從 user-level 穩定分流起步，預先定義 eligible population。
Begin with stable user-level assignment and a predefined eligible population.
檢查 cross-device、session 重入與共同 advertiser budget 的干擾。
Inspect cross-device exposure, re-entry, and shared advertiser-budget interference.
Power / window
Power / window
用分流單位的變異估 MDE 與樣本量；包含週期與 label 成熟時間。
Estimate MDE/sample size at the assignment unit; include cycles and label maturity.
事前選 fixed horizon 或有效 sequential 方法，避免每日偷看後任意停止。
Prespecify a fixed horizon or valid sequential method; avoid arbitrary stopping after peeking.
Validity
Validity
檢查 SRM、日誌、render coverage、assignment 版本與排除規則。
Check SRM, logs, render coverage, assignment versions, and exclusions.
解決資料品質問題再解讀 lift；不能悄悄丟掉異常 arm。
Resolve data-quality problems before interpreting lift; do not silently drop an arm.
Decision
Decision
報效果量、confidence interval、guardrails、slices 與實際成本。
Report effect sizes, confidence intervals, guardrails, slices, and real cost.
CTR 上升但 ad hides／轉換品質惡化，需重新檢查目標。
Higher CTR with more ad hides or worse conversion quality requires revisiting the objective.

text: 示範主指標可選 revenue／eligible user，但這是產品選擇，並非通用答案。CTR 是 ratio，需保留 clicks 和 impressions 的變化，避免把分母減少誤判為改善。若 treatment 影響哪些使用者被觸發，只分析事後被曝光者會引入選擇偏差；從預先界定母體做 intention-to-treat 分析，再做有理由的診斷。

Revenue per eligible user is one illustrative primary metric, not a universal choice. CTR is a ratio: inspect clicks and impressions separately so denominator changes are not mistaken for benefit. If treatment changes who is triggered, conditioning on post-treatment exposure introduces selection bias. Start with intention-to-treat analysis of a predefined population, then add justified diagnostics.

q: 廣告主預算同時服務 control 與 treatment，怎麼辦？
What if advertiser budgets serve both arms?
a: Treatment 可能提早耗盡某些預算而改變 control 的可用候選，破壞無干擾假設。先說明想估的效應，視市場結構考慮 budget isolation、cluster randomization 或有 washout 的 switchback，並評估功效與外推限制。沒有一種分流方式適用所有市場。

Treatment can exhaust budgets earlier and change control's eligible candidates, violating no-interference assumptions. Define the estimand, then consider budget isolation, cluster randomization, or switchbacks with washout as the marketplace permits. Evaluate power and generalization limits; no assignment scheme fits every market.

title: Serving：延遲、共用計算與版本發布

lead: 模型前後還有取特徵、cache、queueing、校準與投放規則。以 end-to-end request 為單位 profile，別只報單次 forward 的平均時間。
A forward pass sits inside feature fetches, caches, queues, calibration, and delivery rules. Profile end-to-end requests instead of reporting average forward time alone.

Batching
同一 request 的候選批次計算；跨 request microbatch 有 deadline。
Batch candidates within a request; deadline-bound cross-request microbatches.
Throughput 提升可能增加等待；固定 arrival process 測尾延遲。
Throughput gains may add queueing; measure tails under a specified arrival process.
User compute sharing
User compute sharing

Reuse user-only encoding before candidate-conditioned interactions.
檢查候選依賴邊界與 cached embedding 相容性。
Verify candidate-dependency boundaries and cached-embedding compatibility.
Quantization
Quantization
依硬體和敏感度選 precision，保留較敏感模組精度。
Choose precision by hardware and sensitivity; preserve sensitive modules.
比較校準、極端機率、cold-start 與線上 kernels 的一致性。
Check calibration, extreme probabilities, cold start, and actual serving kernels.
Feature fetch
Feature fetch
批次讀取、bounded parallelism、freshness-aware cache。
Batched reads, bounded parallelism, freshness-aware caches.
TTL 不是品質保證；資料 age 與 missingness 必須量測。
TTL does not guarantee quality; measure age and missingness.
Fallback
Fallback
允許缺 optional feature；失敗時走已測試的輕模型或保守策略。
Allow optional-feature loss; use an evaluated lighter model or conservative policy.
不得用隨意常數掩蓋故障；保留 calibration 與版本紀錄。
Do not hide failure with arbitrary constants; retain calibration/version logs.

caption: 版本化 bundle 與 serving 契約示意
Illustrative versioned bundle and serving contract

text: 發布時先跑 tensor／prediction parity 和固定負載測試，再 shadow 觀察實際缺值與尾延遲，最後 canary 評估完整決策。Shadow 不影響曝光，所以不能直接估新 policy 的真實 CTR。Rollback 要回整個相容 bundle，必要時連 user／creative embeddings 一起回退或路由到相容版本。

Before release, run tensor/prediction parity and fixed-load tests, shadow real missingness and tail latency, then canary the actual decisions. Shadowing does not change exposure and cannot directly estimate the new policy's realized CTR. Roll back a compatible bundle, including embeddings or routing to compatible encoder versions where required.

q: 服務 HTTP 200，但 pCTR 全部接近零？
HTTP 200, but almost all pCTR values approach zero?
a: 先比 model／feature／calibrator 版本、特徵 coverage 與分布，檢查是不是 vocabulary 失配、zero-filled tensors、precision 問題或錯誤校準。若模型剛更新，回 last-known-good bundle；若 input 壞掉，切健康 fallback 並阻擋用受污染資料繼續訓練。

Compare model/feature/calibrator versions, coverage, and distributions. Check vocabulary mismatches, zero-filled tensors, precision, and calibration. Roll back a newly released bundle; for corrupted inputs, route to a healthy fallback and block training on contaminated data.

Monitor four layers: data health (coverage, lag, deduplication), features/models (schema, distributions, age, predictions), decisions (eligibility, auctions, budgets), and outcomes (mature CTR/conversions, negative feedback). Give alerts an owner, severity, freeze/fallback/rollback action, and recovery condition rather than stopping at a dashboard.

Synthetic impression/click streams, controllable clocks, late/duplicate/missing events.
驗 join／label maturity，不把合成結果當真實模型收益。
Validate joins/maturity; do not present synthetic results as real model lift.

D · Serving

Batched scoring API, versioned bundle, fallback, load generator.
報硬體、候選數、arrival rate、warm／cold cache、p95／p99。

text: Repo 的 demo 只是入口。面試更有價值的展示是：你發現了哪個資料／評估陷阱、如何修正、哪個假說沒有成立，以及品質改善花了多少算力。不要捏造 online lift；沒有流量時，以離線結果與 mock／load test 的範圍如實呈現。

A repository demo is a starting point. A stronger interview artifact explains a data/evaluation trap you found, its correction, a failed hypothesis, and the compute cost of any gain. Do not invent online lift; without production traffic, report the limits of offline results and mock/load tests.

title: 45 分鐘回答流程與深入追問
A 45-minute answer flow and deeper follow-ups
lead: 沿六步回答，每一步都說出一個具體選擇、一個取捨和一個驗證方法。先閉卷口說，再展開中英答案。
Use six stages, each with a concrete choice, tradeoff, and validation method. Rehearse without the text before opening either language.

q: 00–05 · 釐清產品目標
00–05 · Clarify the product goal
a: 我先把任務限於社群 feed 的精排 CTR，預測有效曝光後 W 內的落地頁點擊。確認版位、候選量、延遲、click 定義和可用特徵。模型輸出條件機率，下游再結合競價與品質限制；線上主要價值指標和負回饋、延遲護欄需先對齊。

I will scope this to CTR prediction for social-feed ranking: a landing-page click within W after a valid impression. I will clarify placement, candidate volume, latency, click semantics, and available features. The model produces a conditional probability; downstream auction and quality rules consume it. We should agree on a primary value metric and negative-feedback/latency guardrails first.

q: 05–13 · 資料與標籤
05–13 · Data and labels
a: 一筆樣本是一筆 rendered impression，以 impression ID join 去重後的 click。使用 event time 定義窗口，arrival time 控制資料可用性；成熟且來源健康後才定案負例。特徵用 serving snapshot 或雙時間條件重建，按時間切 train／validation／calibration／test。若抽負例，保存保留率並修正 posterior 或 loss。未曝光候選不直接標 0。

One example is a rendered impression joined to deduplicated clicks by impression ID. Event time defines the target window; arrival time governs availability. Finalize negatives only after maturity with healthy sources. Use serving snapshots or time-aware reconstruction, split chronologically into train/validation/calibration/test, and log retention rates if sampling negatives. Correct either the posterior or loss appropriately. Unshown candidates are not zero-label examples.

q: 13–25 · Baseline／模型
13–25 · Baselines and models
a: 先用 LR／FTRL 和 user、ad、context、平滑歷史統計建立 baseline。固定資料比較 DeepFM 或 DCNv2 的交互收益；再以行為歷史是否有 candidate-specific 訊號決定加 DIN 或序列模型。解釋 BCE、sampling、OOV 和模型輸出。用 pooled／shuffled／ordered history、content ablation 與公平調參驗證假說，不因模型新就選它。

Start with LR/FTRL and user, ad, context, and smoothed history features. With fixed data, test interaction gains from DeepFM or DCNv2. Add DIN or sequence models only for a hypothesis about candidate-specific history or temporal signal. Explain BCE, sampling, OOV handling, and output semantics. Use pooled/shuffled/ordered histories, content ablations, and fair tuning budgets to test the hypothesis rather than selecting by novelty.

q: 25–33 · 訓練與部署
25–33 · Training and deployment
a: 先批次重訓並獨立量 feature／model age，視收益再加近線更新。高 cardinality embeddings 估 optimizer memory、sharding 和 communication。Serving 批次處理候選、共用 user-only 計算，設定 feature deadline 與已測 fallback。把 vocabulary、encoder、模型與 calibrator 作相容 bundle 發布，經 parity、shadow、canary 後放量，資料污染時凍結更新。

Begin with batch training and measure feature/model age separately before adding nearline updates. Budget optimizer memory, sharding, and communication for high-cardinality embeddings. Batch candidates, share user-only computation, and define feature deadlines and evaluated fallbacks. Release vocabulary, encoders, model, and calibrator as a compatible bundle through parity checks, shadowing, and canaries; freeze updates when data is contaminated.

q: 33–41 · 離線評估／線上實驗
33–41 · Offline and online evaluation
a: 離線以未來資料報 log loss、明確定義的 NE、AUC 和 calibration；按新廣告、版位、活躍度與 freshness 切片，使用適合相關結構的 uncertainty。線上先確認分流與 SRM，預先定義主要指標、MDE、觀察窗和 guardrails。共享 advertiser budget 可能造成干擾，需要評估隔離或不同 randomization。不能由 AUC 推導收入 lift。

On future data, report log loss, explicitly defined NE, AUC, and calibration, sliced by new ads, placement, activity, and freshness with dependence-aware uncertainty. Online, validate assignment and SRM, and prespecify the primary metric, MDE, observation window, and guardrails. Shared advertiser budgets may require isolation or a different randomization design. AUC does not establish revenue lift.

q: 41–45 · 失敗案例與取捨
41–45 · Failures and tradeoffs
a: 若 click source 中斷，我會先凍結錯誤 labels 和更新，保留健康 bundle，再回補；若 user embedding 過期或版本不符，走相容 fallback。最後以資料新鮮度、模型容量與成本的實驗曲線決定下一步。我會明確區分已知證據、設計假設和仍需驗證的部分。

If the click source fails, freeze bad labels and updates, preserve the healthy bundle, and backfill. For stale or incompatible user embeddings, use a compatible fallback. Choose the next investment from measured freshness, capacity, and cost curves. Distinguish established evidence, design assumptions, and remaining validation.

q: 追問：只有 click logs，沒有曝光紀錄？
Follow-up: clicks but no impression logs?
a: 沒有 denominator，也不知道哪些廣告有機會被點，不能直接訓練或評估標準 impression CTR。先改善 logging，或重新定義可識別的任務，例如 click-conditioned next-item prediction，並清楚說它不是 pCTR。隨機拿未點廣告當負例無法恢復缺失的曝光機制。

There is no denominator or record of click opportunities, so standard impression CTR is not identifiable from those logs alone. Improve logging or redefine an identifiable task such as click-conditioned next-item prediction, explicitly distinguishing it from pCTR. Random unclicked ads do not reconstruct the missing exposure mechanism.

q: 追問：校準比例等於 1，還有問題嗎？
Follow-up: calibration ratio is 1; are we done?
a: 沒有。高估一群、低估另一群可能相互抵消；不同分數區間也可能失準。檢查 reliability plot、slice counts、Brier／loss 與 ranker 使用機率的區域。校準器的資料分布和時間也要匹配目標流量。

No. Overprediction in one group can offset underprediction in another, and score ranges can be miscalibrated. Inspect reliability plots, slice counts, Brier/loss, and the probability ranges used by the ranker. The calibrator's data distribution and time period must match target traffic.

q: 追問：你如何設計一個有研究價值的下一步？
Follow-up: what is a research-worthy next step?
a: 提出可辨識的假說，例如多樣事件是否比同長度單一 click 序列更有用。控制事件數、時間跨度、模型容量與 tuning budget，分別消融 action type、順序和內容表示。用多時段、cold-start slices、uncertainty 與 cost-quality curve 判斷結果；保留不成立的假說和 failure analysis。

Propose an identifiable hypothesis, such as whether diverse event types outperform equally long click-only histories. Control event count, time span, capacity, and tuning budget; ablate action type, order, and content independently. Evaluate multiple periods, cold-start slices, uncertainty, and cost-quality curves, retaining negative results and failure analysis.

title: 健康基準
Healthy baseline
facts: 曝光與 click 都準時到達，feature schema 相容；新模型離線 loss 略降，p99 符合預算。
Impressions/clicks arrive on time, schemas match, and a candidate slightly improves offline loss within the p99 budget.
decision: 檢查校準、slices 與重播一致性，通過後進入預先定義的 canary／A/B。
Check calibration, slices, and replay parity, then proceed to the predefined canary/A/B plan.
check: 成功條件是受控線上結果，不是訓練 loss 下降。
Success means controlled online outcomes, not merely lower training loss.

title: 窗內晚到點擊
Late in-window click
facts: 10:00 曝光；五分鐘 target。Click 在 10:04 發生，10:08 到達；10:05 的資料仍未完整。
Impression at 10:00, five-minute target. Click occurs at 10:04 and arrives at 10:08; data is incomplete at 10:05.
decision: 保留 pending 或依成熟政策處理；以 event time 標成正例。若已定案，依版本修正／回補政策處理同一曝光。
Keep pending or follow the maturity policy; label positive by event time. If finalized, correct/backfill the same exposure under the versioning policy.
check: 10:06 才發生的點擊是窗外事件，與窗內晚到不同。
A click occurring at 10:06 is outside the target, unlike an in-window late arrival.

title: Click 日誌中斷
Click-log outage
facts: 曝光量正常，click ingest 突降為零；來源 lag 飆升，新 batch 的 CTR 異常低。
Impressions remain normal, click ingestion falls to zero, source lag spikes, and the new batch CTR collapses.
decision: 隔離 labels、凍結更新與發布，保留健康 serving bundle。恢復後核對 completeness 再回補。
Quarantine labels, freeze training/release, and preserve the healthy serving bundle. Backfill after recovery and completeness checks.
check: 等待成熟窗口不能補回遺失事件；不要自動把它解釋成使用者興趣改變。
A maturity window cannot restore lost events; do not automatically interpret this as changing user interest.

title: 快取向量不相容
Incompatible cached vectors
facts: Ranker 預期 user encoder v8，cache 還有 v7；向量維度相同，因此 API 沒報錯。
The ranker expects user encoder v8, but the cache contains v7. Dimensions match, so the API reports no error.
decision: 檢查語意版本，路由到相容 bundle、重算或用已測 fallback；分群監控 feature age 和輸出。
Validate semantic versions, route to a compatible bundle, recompute or use evaluated fallback; monitor age and predictions by slice.
check: 相同 tensor shape 不代表 embedding space 相容。
Equal tensor shapes do not imply compatible embedding spaces.

title: 全新廣告
New ad
facts: 新 ad ID 未見過，creative 圖文可用；同 advertiser 有歷史但只有少量新廣告曝光。
An unseen ad ID has text/image content; the advertiser has history but the new ad has few impressions.
decision: 用 OOV／新 ID 路徑、content 與 advertiser prior；量 cold-start 校準，若產品允許則有限探索。
Use the OOV/new-ID path, content, and advertiser prior; evaluate cold-start calibration and bounded exploration if permitted.
check: 不要把一次點擊／一次曝光的 100% CTR 當可靠機率。
One click from one impression does not justify a reliable 100% probability.

title: AUC 好、收益差
AUC up, value down
facts: AUC 小幅提升，但新模型普遍高估 pCTR，還增加 deadline misses；線上價值指標下降。
AUC improves slightly, but pCTR is overestimated and deadline misses increase; online value falls.
decision: 分別檢查 calibrator、抽樣修正、版本與 latency；固定候選做 replay，再以隔離實驗確認原因。
Inspect calibration, sampling correction, versions, and latency separately; replay fixed candidates and isolate causes experimentally.
check: 排序辨識力、機率尺度與成功服務率是不同面向。
Discrimination, probability scale, and successful serving are distinct dimensions.
